metaTitle: Graduation Party Dessert Cups for Open Houses
metaDescription: Hand-layered graduation party dessert cups in packs of 24, 48 or 96, made fresh the morning of pickup or delivery. Hamilton pickup or Saturday GTA delivery.
h1: Graduation party dessert cups for the open-house crowd
intro: Graduation party dessert cups for the way open houses actually run: guests arrive in waves, not all at once. Each hand-layered cup comes ready to grab, with nothing to slice or plate. Every order is made fresh the morning of pickup in Hamilton or Saturday delivery across the GTA.

sections.heading: Made for a party with no real start time
sections.body:
Grad parties don't really start at a set time. Grandparents come early, the team shows up after practice, and the neighbours wander over when they spot the balloons. If the dessert needs cutting and plating, someone ends up on dessert duty instead of at the party.

Dessert cups skip that job. Guests help themselves as they arrive, and whoever would have been holding the cake knife gets to stay in the photos.

sections.heading: Mini Shots or Dessert Cups for a grad party
sections.body:
**Mini Shots** (2 oz, a tasting size) suit an open house that already has a grad cake or a full buffet, so guests can try a flavour or two between photos.

**Dessert Cups** (5 oz, a full serving) are the call when the cups are the dessert.

A starting point, and a suggestion rather than a rule: when you count, include everyone who'll come through over the whole party, not only the people in the room at one time. Then plan about one Dessert Cup or about two Mini Shots per guest.

Say about 40 people drop by between 2 and 6, but never more than 15 at once. Plan for 40, not 15: about 40 Dessert Cups or about 80 Mini Shots, which points to a 48 of Dessert Cups or a 96 of Mini Shots. You know your crowd, so adjust from there.

[Compare every size and price](/packages)

sections.heading: The 96, for the big open house
sections.body:
Is the guest list the whole extended family, half the graduating class and most of the street? You might start with the 96. It includes:

- a presentation tray
- event-day pickup
- a custom label option (mention it in your request)
- room for up to 16 flavours, with a minimum of 6 cups per flavour

From $168 for 96 Mini Shots; [every price](/packages).

More guests than one 96 covers? Put your headcount in the notes, and we'll talk it through when we confirm.

[Start a 96 of Dessert Cups](/order?pack=96&size=5oz&event=graduation) or [a 96 of Mini Shots](/order?pack=96&size=2oz&event=graduation)

sections.heading: Smaller grad party? The 24 or the 48
sections.body:
For a backyard dinner with close family, a 24 may be enough. It holds up to 4 flavours, from $45 for Mini Shots or from $99 for Dessert Cups.

The 48, our most popular size, holds up to 8 flavours, from $88 for Mini Shots or from $199 for Dessert Cups. [See what each pack includes](/packages).

[Build a 48 for your grad](/order?pack=48&size=5oz&event=graduation)

sections.heading: School colours, using the cups' real colours
sections.body:
These are the cups' own fixed colours, so aim for close to your school colours rather than an exact match. Some pairings that work:

- **Green and gold:** [Dubai Chocolate](/menu/dubai-chocolate) (pale green pistachio cream, golden kunafa strands mid-cup, dark ganache and a green marbled swirl on top) with [Mango Dream](/menu/mango-dream) (saffron-orange mango over pale yellow cream).
- **Purple and gold:** [Blueberry Haze](/menu/blueberry-haze) (lilac cream under a near-black violet compote) with Mango Dream or [Biscoff Bliss](/menu/biscoff-bliss) (caramel-tan cream, amber top).
- **Red and white:** [Strawberry Fields](/menu/strawberry-fields), a glossy red compote over blush-pink cream with cream rosettes on top.
- **Black and gold (near enough):** [Ferrero Royale](/menu/ferrero-royale)'s dark glossy ganache under a hazelnut sphere, with Biscoff Bliss's amber top for the gold.
- **Blue:** there's no blue cup. Blueberry Haze reads lilac and violet, not blue. Let the napkins and balloons carry the blue, and pick flavours for taste.

To build colour blocks, split a 48 into 24 and 24 across two flavours, or a 96 into four blocks of 24. Every flavour needs at least 6 cups. A box that's half Dubai Chocolate (Premium) and half Mango Dream (Classic) is priced cup by cup, so its price falls between the all-Classic and all-Premium prices.

[Order a 96 starting with Dubai Chocolate](/order?pack=96&size=5oz&flavour=dubai&event=graduation)

sections.heading: Planning around grad season
sections.body:
Grad season is a busy stretch for families: the ceremony, photos, relatives in from out of town, then the party. Sort out dessert early so it isn't a last-minute job.

- **As soon as you have a date:** send your request. There's no online payment, and we confirm within the day.
- **No later than 48 hours before:** the minimum notice for a standard order.
- **Under 48 hours:** this counts as urgent. It's subject to availability, with no guarantee.
- **Party on a Saturday:** delivery is an option. [Delivery runs Saturdays across the GTA](/dessert-cups-gta), and the fee depends on your location and is quoted after we confirm your order. A midweek ceremony with the party on the Saturday after lines up with the delivery day.
- **Prefer pickup?** [Pickup free in Hamilton.](/dessert-cups-hamilton) It's by arrangement, and we share the location once your order is confirmed.
- **The morning of:** your cups are made fresh the morning of pickup or delivery.

sections.heading: Nuts and dairy at a self-serve table
sections.body:
An open house brings in people you don't know well, like teammates, classmates' parents and coworkers' kids. You won't be standing at the dessert table when someone asks what's in a cup, so think about allergens before you pick flavours.

The allergen notice at the bottom of every page covers dairy, tree nuts and cross-contact. For an open house, the practical read is this: leaving the flavours flagged for tree nuts off the table works for preference, not for an allergy, because every cup comes out of the same kitchen. If a guest has a severe allergy, talk to us before you order, and if you'd like a card beside each flavour, the [FAQ](/faq) has the details to put on it.

sections.heading: From request to party table
sections.body:
[Start your order](/order?event=graduation) and pick your pack, size and flavours, your date, and pickup or delivery. Use the notes for your party hours and any questions, such as how to keep the cups until they're served. Ordering a 96? Mention the custom label there too. Still deciding? See the [FAQ](/faq) or browse [other events](/events).

The total on the form is an estimate, before delivery, and you don't pay anything online. We confirm within the day. For delivery, the fee is quoted after we confirm; for pickup, we share the location once your order is confirmed. Then we make your cups.

faqs.q: How many dessert cups do I need for a graduation open house?
faqs.a: This is a suggestion, not a rule. Count everyone who'll come through over the whole party, then plan about one Dessert Cup (5 oz) or about two Mini Shots (2 oz) per guest. Packs come in 24, 48 and 96. If one pack isn't enough, put your headcount in the notes.

faqs.q: Can the cups match our school colours?
faqs.a: Close, not exact. Each flavour has its own fixed colours, and none is blue.
